title: いつか交わるその日まで！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Chiyono O and Ardan both injure themselves at the Japanese Derby and won't be able to race for a while.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I know they'll be back on the track someday! After all, there's still a bunch of fiery races like the Derby that we need to run together!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno and I vow to work hard so we can be worthy rivals to Chiyono O and Ardan when they return!
